body:
Adds `research/roundtrip-twin` (companion to `uav-energy-twin` and `drag-twin`): wind does not cancel over a round trip (real/twin energy 1/(1-(w/v)^2)), the twin-optimal airspeed is too slow, and a one-leg-calibrated twin is off by exactly ±w/v with the sign of the leg flown. 9 tests, README, white paper, results, README bullet and site/projects.json entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
